headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Action Spreads
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the front has stirred in several sectors rather than settling into one decisive line. WeatheredExpanse remains the busiest ledger, with 55 base events in the past day and three in the latest two hours; its holdings stand at four Warden, two Colonial, and three neutral bases, amid sharply accelerating casualty rates. KuuraStrand has reopened as an immediate contest, recording five events in two hours and 15 across the day, with three Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base. NevishLine likewise shows four fresh events and accelerating losses on both sides, while PariPeak has three recent events and 22 daily. LinnMercy is still active at Outwich Ranch, with two events in the latest two hours and 16 across the day. MarbanHollow’s mixed ledger remains unsettled, though its 28 daily events were followed by a quiet latest two-hour window. Gutter, once the day’s most frenetic exchange, has 53 events but none recently. CallahansPassage and Stonecradle report heavy, accelerating casualties without confirmed base events; most rear regions remain quiet.
